headline: Fed Staff Economic Outlook showed the inflation outlook was similar to one prepared for the June meeting, but the economic outlook was a touch weaker.
Fed Minutes: A couple of participants said ample-reserves regime had helped maintain orderly market functioning during brief payments outage during intermeeting period.
Fed Minutes: Fed staff economic outlook showed inflation forecast was similar to one prepared for the June meeting, but the economic outlook was a touch weaker.
Fed Minutes: Several participants said price increases over the past year were broad-based, spanning various categories of goods and services.
Fed Minutes: No decisions were made on the number of meetings, and Warsh indicated no change to the 2026 schedule.
Fed Minutes: Almost all FOMC members agreed it was appropriate to retain policy statement language affirming FOMC 'will deliver price stability’.

Fed Minutes: Various participants said tighter financial conditions over the intermeeting period reflected strong economic growth and expectations for the Fed to adopt a more restrictive stance before long.
Fed Minutes: Chairman Warsh said six scheduled meetings per year, held roughly every two months, would allow more information to accumulate between meetings.
Fed Minutes: A few participants who favored raising rates at the meeting judged that doing so would likely help forestall the need for further hikes.
